issues.main_description_html:
Assignee: Muhamad Rifky — Developer

Description

Move the public live view to the shareable key route.

Route change — /live/{projectId} (src/app/live/[projectId]/page.tsx) becomes map-thru.com/v/{key} (src/app/v/[key]/page.tsx). The page resolves the project by project_key via the BE public lookup GET /v1/live/{key} (BE task GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#84). Old /live/{projectId} links should stop being generated anywhere in the app (share link, embed, "View project live").

The social share card (Open Graph / Twitter meta) is split out to #250.

Acceptance Criteria

  • map-thru.com/v/{key} renders the live view (same viewer as before, no owner chrome)
  • Invalid/unknown key shows the existing error state (no crash)
  • All in-app share/embed/"View live" links point to /v/{key}
  • next.config.ts frame-ancestors exemption follows the route (/live/* → /v/*)

Dependencies

GoThruMedia/Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO#84 — project_key field + public lookup by key. Done — endpoint is GET /v1/live/{key} (src/routes/v1/floorplan.go), public, gated on status = 'published', same response shape as GET /v1/floorplan/{id}.

RESULT

PR: #257 — branch feature/245-live-route-to-v-key → development

Frontend only, no backend change. Six commits: design doc, plan, data layer, the /v/[key] page, link generation, then the /live deletion.

What changed

File Change
src/actions/projects.ts project_key: string on the Project type; new getLiveFloorplanAction(key)
src/app/v/[key]/page.tsx new — the public viewer, resolved by key
src/app/live/[projectId]/page.tsx deleted
src/lib/preview/publish.ts publicProjectUrl(projectKey, origin) builds /v/{key}
src/components/preview/PreviewTopbar.tsx keeps project_key from the getProject call it already makes
src/components/preview/PreviewShareModal.tsx prop projectId → projectKey
src/components/dashboard/ProjectViews.tsx passes projectKey={project.project_key}
next.config.ts frame-ancestors exemption moved /live/* → /v/*

Behaviour change: /live/{projectId} served any status, so a draft was reachable by direct URL. GET /v1/live/{key} gates on status = 'published' — a draft's key now shows the error state. Intended; the old gotcha dies with the route.

Decisions

  • The live page stores no project identity — unconditional reset(), deliberately not setProjectId(key). setProjectId writes localStorage.gf_project_id, which bare /editor reads to redirect an owner to /editor/{id}; a share key there would send them to /editor/{8-char-key}.
  • The old route is deleted, not redirected — /live was not yet public-facing, and a redirect would need an id→key lookup with no public endpoint (getProject is auth-gated).

Verified (dev server): /live/anything → 404; /v/aaaaaaaa → frame-ancestors * with no X-Frame-Options; /dashboard → SAMEORIGIN + frame-ancestors 'self'; unknown key → error state, zero console errors; gf_project_id seeded with a UUID stays unchanged after visiting /v/{key}, and bare /editor still lands on /editor/{uuid}.

Two test files fail on this branch (ENOENT on new-ui/new-editor/public/sample.txt and samples/sample2-txt/a.txt) — pre-existing, reproduced at base e27aaae, unrelated.

Open — needs a signed-in owner with a published project (DISABLE_AUTH=false; the BE returns 401 without a token). The two unchecked ACs above are unchecked for this reason only:

  • /v/{key} renders the viewer for a published project, no owner chrome
  • Share modal link → /v/{key}
  • Embed snippet → /v/{key}
  • "View project live" → /v/{key}

Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-16-live-route-v-key.md

issues.display_title: Issue #256: feat(profile): wire change-password to API + handle Google accounts
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Wire the Change Password flow on the profile page to the existing backend endpoint.

Backend endpoint is ready: POST /v1/auth/password/change
Request body: { currentPassword, newPassword }

Frontend gap:

  • No changePasswordAction server action in src/actions/auth.ts
  • PasswordSection in src/app/profile/page.tsx has UI but "Update password" button has no onClick

Acceptance Criteria

  • Add changePasswordAction(currentPassword, newPassword) to src/actions/auth.ts
    • Reads session token via auth() and passes it as Authorization: Bearer header
    • Calls POST /v1/auth/password/change
    • Returns typed result: { success: true } or { error: string }
  • Wire PasswordSection button to the action
    • Show loading state while request is in-flight
    • On success: clear all three fields + show success toast/message
    • On error: show error message inline (e.g. "Incorrect current password")
  • Handle Google-provisioned accounts
    • Backend skips currentPassword check if user has no password hash (Google OAuth accounts)
    • Frontend must detect this case (can use getMeAction to check if account was created via Google / has no password)
    • If Google account: hide the "Old password" field and show a note: "Your account uses Google sign-in. Enter a new password to add email login."
  • Validation matches backend rules: new password >= 8 characters, confirm matches
  • Builds, typechecks, and lints green

Files to touch

  • src/actions/auth.ts — add changePasswordAction
  • src/app/profile/page.tsx — wire PasswordSection, add Google-account UX

Notes

  • Backend action (src/action/v1/auth/change_password.go) skips current-password bcrypt check when user.Password == "" — that is the signal for Google-provisioned accounts
  • Frontend needs a way to know if the logged-in user is Google-provisioned; check if getMeAction exposes this or if a new field is needed from the API

RESULT

Implemented on branch worktree-256-change-password-integration (PR #260).

Files changed:

  • src/actions/auth.ts — added changePasswordAction calling POST /v1/auth/password/change with Bearer token; moved getToken to shared src/lib/server/session.ts
  • src/actions/projects.ts — exposed hasPassword from getMeAction via has_password field from /me endpoint; imports getToken from shared module
  • src/app/profile/page.tsx — wired PasswordSection with loading/success/error state, skeleton while account type loads, Google-account UX (hide old-password field, show sign-in note)
  • src/lib/server/session.ts — new shared getToken helper (eliminates duplication between action files)

Commits:

  • 702c6af — feat(profile): wire change-password to API + handle Google accounts
  • d97f89a — fix(profile): harden change-password after code review (try/finally, skeleton loader, getMeAction fallback, deduplicate getToken)
